By way of the present petition, the petitioners seek quashing of proceedings pending before the learned Trial Court pursuant to FIR No. 789/2021 dated 29.12.2021, registered at Police Station Prem Nagar, for offences under Sections 498A/406/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.

2. The FIR was registered on a complaint given by Respondent No. 2/ complainant alleging cruelty and harassment for dowry by her husband and his relatives, including, the petitioners who are the Father-In-Law and Mother-In-Law of the complainant.

3. The learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the marriage between the son of the petitioners and the complainant happened on 28.06.2019 and it was in fact the complainant who had been harassing the petitioners, which led to Petitioner No.2 making a complaint to the Police on 23.11.2019.
4. He submits that the petitioners disowned their son and the complainant and the complainant did not stay in the matrimonial home.

sentences.text: He submits that as a counterblast, the present FIR was thereafter registered at the instance of the complainant on 29.12.2021.
7. He submits that the facts clearly indicate false implication of the petitioners.

He, however, at the outset, fairly states that since the matter is listed before the learned Trial Court for consideration of the chargesheet, all arguments will be taken before the learned Trial Court.
8. He seeks liberty to withdraw the present petition with liberty to file afresh in case any grievance remains in future.
He, however, prays that considering the age of the petitioners and the nature of dispute, they may be exempted from personal appearance before the learned Trial Court.
9. Considering the above, the present petition is disposed of with liberty to the petitioners to raise all arguments before the learned Trial Court.

10. Furthermore, considering the facts of the case and age of the petitioners, they are exempted from personal appearance before the learned Trial Court and are permitted to appear through video-conference.
AMIT MAHAJAN, J SEPTEMBER 3, 2025 "SS"
